metadataRaw.title: How to PREVENT Back Pain #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy way to strengthen muscles that support the back, helping to 'future-proof' it and prevent injuries. 

This exercise will focus on both the back and front (the core muscles) to cover all bases. It requires no equipment and can be done daily at home.

Let us know how it works for you!
